item.title: Irish Heritage Month Presentations @ Tewksbury Lodge
item.description: In tandem with Irish Heritage Month, a series of presentations will be held at Tewksbury Lodge along the Niagara River. This speaker series will be held every Wednesday in March, and no reservations are necessary. The series is as follows: A $10 donation is encouraged. Food and beverages will be available from 5:30 p.m. to 7 p.m. Tewksbury Lodge | 249 Ohio Street | Buffalo, NY 14204 Read more at Irish Heritage Month Presentations @ Tewksbury Lodge on Buffalo Rising.

item.title: Done Deal: Jemal Residence at 135 Nottingham
item.description: Norman and Morris Jemal, developer Douglas Jemal’s sons, sold 135 Nottingham Terrace yesterday. The property was listed at the end of January with a $2.5 million asking price, went pending in one day, and sold for $2.75 million. The buyer, aptly named 135 Nottingham LLC, was registered on February 11 with a 50 Fountain Plaza, suite 1700, offices for law firm Lippes Mathias. item.title: Opportunity Knocks: 543 Franklin Street Includes “Rare Stone Sauna House”
item.description: Seeing 543 Franklin Street being listed for sale brought up a lot of memories for me. This was once the home, and place of business, for Sandy Hertel, who ran a fabric shop out of the circa 1852 residence. Before her passing in 2017, Sandy was an devout preservationist, and community activist. She made her mark from the mid-lower West Side to Elmwood Avenue to Allentown.
